title: Follon PAPER Command Route Configuration v1

instrument_tick_sizes.description: Venue tick size per tradable instrument. An order for an unlisted instrument, or a limit price off its instrument's grid, is refused before it can reach the broker.

instrument_lot_sizes.description: Venue lot size per tradable instrument: the exact quantity increment. An order for an unlisted instrument, or a quantity (for a combination, each leg's contract quantity) that is not a whole number of lots, is refused before it can reach the broker. It must list exactly the instruments instrument_tick_sizes lists; a configuration that lists an instrument in only one of the two tables is refused at startup.

adapter_kind.description: IBKR_PAPER_MODEL is the in-process deterministic model. IBKR_PAPER_BRIDGE starts the official-API IBKR PAPER bridge process, which carries single DAY orders only: a combination, a GTC order or a replacement is refused before an order exists.

ibkrBridge.description: How the route starts the official-API IBKR PAPER bridge. The route builds the bridge's argument list from these fields, so no free-form argument reaches the process. The broker account, client id, TWS time zone and the instrument map's SHA-256 are bound into the journal fingerprint.

python_executable.description: Absolute path of the approved interpreter; the process gets no PATH.

port.description: The PAPER TWS (7497) or PAPER Gateway (4002) port.

broker_account.description: The IBKR paper account identifier: account metadata, not a credential.

instrument_map.description: A regular file of at most 1 MiB, in the bridge's instrument-map format.

tws_timezone.description: The IANA time zone TWS reports execution times in.

request_timeout_seconds.description: The route's deadline for each bridge request. The bridge's own IBKR timeout is two seconds shorter.
